I answered Pree in the thread under her message in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

The answer comes from her own post in #central-team on 9 June 2026. She said Pine Crossing's morning receiver reported that the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note instead. Hollis said he would check the shift template.

I didn't find a site code or address for Pine Crossing, either in that channel or in the shared files Pree can see. There are no Marrow Agrisupply account files there. I told her that if the account sheet needs a site code, it will have to come from the store list. I only looked at things Pree herself has access to.
